content.short: Arf provides regulated working capital that lets payment firms settle cross-border transfers without prefunding.
content.description: Arf lends licensed payment businesses the money they need to settle a cross-border transfer at the moment it happens, then collects once the funds arrive on the other side. That removes the usual requirement to park cash in destination markets weeks ahead of demand, which is where most of the working capital in remittance sits idle. The credit is short term, backed by receivables and revolving, so treasury teams can run around the clock rather than around banking hours. Based in Zug, Arf works alongside Circle, Stellar and Visa.
